text.description_html:
First Impressions 4 Inch "C" Cabinet Pull

This sleek 4" high pull is great for cabinets and drawers. Use in your kitchen, bathroom, closets... Also used on armoires and other furniture.

This "C" Door Pull is available in other sizes and finishes, Contact Us for more information.

Impeccably hand crafted from high grade 1/2" thick solid brass with polished brass lacquered finish.

Specifications: of First Impressions "C" Door Pull

  • Height: 4"
  • Width: 2"
  • Face: 1"
  • Projection: 2"
  • Mounting Holes: 3-1/4" Center to Center

*Sold individually (1 door pull).
